headline: Small fair-angle SE, light wind — dawn groveler at best.
today: Under 2ft on a fair SE angle, but wind is light NNW then NE through the morning so it's clean if you're not picky. Groveler or log the early incoming tide toward the 1:31p high. Cross-on SE fills in the afternoon — nothing special either way.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle pushes to 3.4ft, the most size of the week, but E onshore 9-12mph is on it all morning. Big but sloppy.
2.8ft on a good SE angle with light E/ESE wind at 4mph — glassy and the pick of the week here. Easy call for the 1.5hr drive; work the morning tide.
